events.title: Accounting for your Future

Register now to secure your spot and join us for a day of learning, networking, and great food. Enjoy free pizza lunch while you engage in meaningful discussions, expand your knowledge, and connect with peers and professionals in the field. What to expect: Explore dynamic and rewarding career opportunities in accounting. Industry professionals will share their experiences, provide insight into various career paths, and discuss the demand for skilled accountants in today’s job market. Discover how you can seamlessly transition from your community college to university business school. Representatives will be on hand to discuss transfer requirements, scholarship opportunities, and how to make the most of your credits. Connect with recruiters from leading accounting firms. All workshops are in-person.

events.title: Happy Hour: Khalid Hanifi Quartet
events.summary: Join us for a free happy hour concert! Khalid Hanifi is an Ann Arbor, Michigan based singer, songwriter and recording artist. Over the course of three decades, leading the bands Map of the World (Atlantic Records), Kiss Me Screaming, Maypops, and now as a solo artist, he has built a deeply compelling body of work that combines uniquely thoughtful, personally and politically charged lyrical content with impeccably crafted, irresistibly infectious melodies.

events.title: Happy Hour: Lamm & Henley
events.summary: Lamm & Henley is an original music duo comprised of August Lamm and Andy Henley. Their music showcases tight musicianship, an inventive vocal blend, and timeless lyricism influenced by the Great American Songbook.

events.title: Happy Hour: LUVPLANET
events.summary: Join us for a free happy hour concert! Singer, Songwriter, Guitarists, Nicole Sutton and Mark McGee are the heart and fire behind Luvplanet and its musical mission! Together with undeniable chemistry they craft magnetic, feel good rock'n'roll filled with potent lyrics, lush vocal harmonies, psychedelic guitar jams and infectious optimism! Mixing Rock, Pop, Country and Blues their timeless songs ignite the hearts of the listeners. Together with drummer Michael Amos and bassist Zak Plantus, they generate a powerful presence and persuasive sound

events.title: Happy Hour: Nick James
events.summary: Join us for a free happy hour concert! Nick James is a Michigan-based singer-songwriter blending soulful vocals, acoustic guitar, and live looping into an intimate, layered sound. His set features a mix of heartfelt original songs, improvisation, and storytelling—building each performance live in the moment, one loop at a time.

events.title: Happy Hour: Patrick Clinton
events.summary: Join us for a free happy hour concert! Patrick Clinton wrote his first song in 1968, and after a long hiatus, he’s at it again. He’s known for offbeat, witty, often hilarious tunes about everything from frogs and chickens to cowboys, mashed potatoes, and doomed romance.

events.title: Happy Hour: Ralph Santarpia
events.summary: Rekindling a music career from the late 60’s, Ralph Santarpia is bringing his pop-style, rockin', rollin' stylings to the North Star Lounge and other small venues to the Ann Arbor area. His music has been heard in movies, on national television and on radio stations across the country.
events.imageAlt: Earthwork Music Collective Ft. Dede Alder, Audra Kubat, and Mike Savina

events.title: Happy Hour: Ruth Theodore
events.summary: Join us for a free happy hour concert! Starting her career as a DIY street busker, and now signed to Ani DiFranco's Righteous Babe records in the USA, distinguished British artist and ‘original folk voice’, Ruth Theodore has been steadily releasing critically acclaimed records for over a decade. An experienced stage performer, Theodore playfully pushes the boundaries of gender and genre with a sense of joyful rebellion, a touch of 1920’s vaudeville theatre and a healthy dose of punk rock attitude.

events.title: Happy Hour: Sage Advice

Iggy primarily created in clay, hand-built stoneware; sculptures defined by texture, balance, and physical presence - often life-sized or larger, rooted in forms that feel familiar yet reimagined. events.title: The Gallery at the Baker House Presents: Joan Witte - A Solo Exhibition
events.summary: The Gallery at the Baker House is pleased to present a solo exhibition of the work of local artist Joan Witte. Witte’s artwork explores the space where the natural world and the inner world meet. Working primarily in oil and encaustic, her paintings invite the viewer to look beyond the recognizable image and connect with something more instinctive: an emotion, a memory, or a feeling that exists just beneath the surface. Witte’s exhibition is on display at VITRINE in Plymouth, MI from September 2 through October 5, 2026 with an artist reception on Sunday, September 20 from 2-4pm.
